name: volcengine-plugins
description: Independent Volcengine MCP tools for images, videos, music v5.0, enhancement and fine subtitle erasure.

interface.shortDescription: 生图、视频、v5 歌曲与配乐、超分、去字幕及画质复查。
interface.longDescription: Independent wrapper for official Volcengine APIs: Seedream images, Seedance videos, v5.0 vocal songs and BGM, MediaKit enhancement and fine subtitle erasure. Music includes native AK/SK signing, free previews, task query, exact audio downloads and optional lyrics/captions metadata. Separate credentials per service; no automatic paid retries, model or billing fallback. Reference-video, subtitle QC and music-generation skills included.
defaultPrompt: Check Volcengine image, video, enhancement and subtitle erasure capabilities and configuration.
Create a v5.0 song from my lyrics or a v5.0 instrumental soundtrack; preview first, then query and download the authorized task.
Remove only hard subtitles with the fine v5 service; preview first and preserve audio and timing.
Plan a reference video with $reference-video-production before authorized generation.
